ai.title: Adjust SEARCH/REPLACE block parsing regex
ai.summary: Updated regexes in generate-diffs-prompt.ts to remove mandatory newline requirements before ======= and after REPLACE markers. This allows more flexible parsing of SEARCH/REPLACE blocks that lack trailing newlines. The change applies to both multi-file and single-file diff parsing functions.

eli5.text: A small behind-the-scenes tweak was made to how the system reads and parses text edits that lack a trailing line break, so both multi-file and single-file processing now handle these cases consistently. If you reviewed the relevant logs or outputs today, you'd notice matching edits are recognized slightly more reliably when the closing marker sits directly at the end of a line, with no visible impact on day-to-day work.

ai.title: Reduce Claude Sonnet maxtokens to 15k in backend
ai.summary: Claude Sonnet max_tokens default reduced from 40,000 to 15,000 in backend/src/claude.ts to allocate more context window space. Eval submodules codebuff-swe-bench and pylint added to evals/test-repos. Non-Sonnet models retain 8096 token limit.

eli5.text: If you were using Claude Sonnet to write or work on a large task, the system now limits how long its replies can get, freeing up space so it can remember more of your conversation at once. The assistant can still read the full context of your request, but it will keep its responses shorter to make room. You would notice this if you asked it to do something that previously produced a very long answer, and you would get a more concise reply instead. Non-Sonnet models were not affected.
